rules.statement: Don't set a package or assembly version (`Version`, `VersionPrefix`, `PackageVersion`, `AssemblyVersion`) in an individual project file; the whole package family gets one version, stamped from the root `version.json` by Nerdbank.GitVersioning.
rules.why: The co-released packages must stay mutually consistent so consumers never hit diamond-dependency version conflicts, and the version stays a property of the commit, so releases can be reproduced from git.
rules.check: Look in .csproj/.props/.targets diffs for hard-coded version properties, or for per-package version overrides that break lockstep.

rules.statement: Keep `cloudBuild.setVersionVariables` set to `false` in `version.json`; a workflow that needs the version calls `nbgv get-version` explicitly instead of turning the export back on.
rules.why: Nerdbank.GitVersioning appends to GITHUB_ENV from parallel MSBuild nodes without a lock. That tears lines in the file and fails jobs whose work succeeded.
rules.check: Flag a diff that sets setVersionVariables to true, or a workflow that reads GitBuildVersion or other NBGV variables from the environment instead of calling `nbgv get-version`.

rules.statement: Keep `assemblyVersion` precision at `major` in `version.json`, so all builds within a major share one assembly binding identity.
rules.why: Minor and patch upgrades then drop in within a major, and different majors load side by side.
rules.check: Flag a change to assemblyVersion precision in version.json.

rules.statement: In a public GitHub repository, don't enable `EmbedAllSources` or embed tracked source in PDBs or packages; rely on `Microsoft.SourceLink.GitHub` with `PublishRepositoryUrl`, and use `EmbedUntrackedSources` only for generated files.
rules.why: Public source can be fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com without authentication, so embedding it only bloats every package.
rules.check: Look for EmbedAllSources, for removal of the SourceLink reference or PublishRepositoryUrl, or for embedded-PDB settings in build files of a public repository.

rules.statement: Packable projects ship a companion `.snupkg` symbol package (`DebugType=portable`, `IncludeSymbols`, `SymbolPackageFormat=snupkg`), and publishing pushes the `.snupkg` beside the `.nupkg`.
rules.why: Consumers need step-into debugging and provenance through the standard NuGet.org symbol server.
rules.check: Flag build-file changes that drop these symbol settings or switch DebugType to embedded, and publish workflows that push only the .nupkg.

rules.statement: Keep `ContinuousIntegrationBuild` set to true when `CI` is true for every project, and keep `CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled` turned on with Central Package Management.
rules.why: CI output must be deterministic and path-normalized, and vulnerable indirect dependencies must be pinned centrally to patched versions.
rules.check: Flag removal or narrowing of these properties in Directory.Build.props or Directory.Packages.props.
